Based on the Microsoft Graph documentation, here's what you need for **Teams meeting recordings access**:

## Required Permissions for Teams Recordings

| Permission | Type | Description |
|------------|------|-------------|
| `OnlineMeetingArtifact.Read.All` | Delegated or Application | **Required** for accessing recordings and artifacts |
| `OnlineMeetings.Read` or `OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite` | Delegated | For meeting metadata (delegated scenarios) |
| `OnlineMeetings.Read.All` or `OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite.All` | Application | For meeting metadata (app-only scenarios) |

## API Endpoints for Recordings

**For scheduled meetings:**
```
GET /users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/{meetingId}/recordings
GET /users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/{meetingId}/recordings/{recordingId}
GET /users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/{meetingId}/recordings/{recordingId}/content
```

**List recordings organized by a user:**
```
GET /users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/getAllRecordings
```

## Key Requirements for Application Access

1. **Application Access Policy** (for app-only tokens):
   - Tenant administrators must create an [application access policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/cloud-communication-online-meeting-application-access-policy)
   - Grant it to specific users to authorize the app to fetch recordings on their behalf

2. **Token endpoint:** Use the standard Microsoft identity platform:
   ```
   https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/token
   ```

3. **Scope for delegated auth:**
   ```
   https://graph.microsoft.com/OnlineMeetingArtifact.Read.All
   https://graph.microsoft.com/OnlineMeetings.Read
   ```

4. **Scope for app-only auth:**
   ```
   https://graph.microsoft.com/.default
   ```
   (with the permissions configured in Azure AD app registration)

## Azure AD App Registration Setup

Ensure your app has these API permissions in Azure Portal:
- `Microsoft Graph` → `OnlineMeetingArtifact.Read.All`

Based on the Microsoft Graph documentation, here's what you need for **Teams meeting recordings access**:

## Required Permissions for Teams Recordings

| Permission | Type | Description |
|------------|------|-------------|
| `OnlineMeetingArtifact.Read.All` | Delegated or Application | **Required** for accessing recordings and artifacts |
| `OnlineMeetings.Read` or `OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite` | Delegated | For meeting metadata (delegated scenarios) |
| `OnlineMeetings.Read.All` or `OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite.All` | Application | For meeting metadata (app-only scenarios) |

## API Endpoints for Recordings

**For scheduled meetings:**
```
GET /users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/{meetingId}/recordings
GET /users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/{meetingId}/recordings/{recordingId}
GET /users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/{meetingId}/recordings/{recordingId}/content
```

**List recordings organized by a user:**
```
GET /users/{userId}/onlineMeetings/getAllRecordings
```

## Key Requirements for Application Access

1. **Application Access Policy** (for app-only tokens):
   - Tenant administrators must create an [application access policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/cloud-communication-online-meeting-application-access-policy)
   - Grant it to specific users to authorize the app to fetch recordings on their behalf

2. **Token endpoint:** Use the standard Microsoft identity platform:
   ```
   https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/token
   ```

3. **Scope for delegated auth:**
   ```
   https://graph.microsoft.com/OnlineMeetingArtifact.Read.All
   https://graph.microsoft.com/OnlineMeetings.Read
   ```

4. **Scope for app-only auth:**
   ```
   https://graph.microsoft.com/.default
   ```
   (with the permissions configured in Azure AD app registration)

## Azure AD App Registration Setup

Ensure your app has these API permissions in Azure Portal:
- `Microsoft Graph` → `OnlineMeetingArtifact.Read.All` 
- `Microsoft Graph` → `OnlineMeetings.Read.All` (for app-only)

Some permissions require **admin consent**.

Namespace: microsoft.graph


Retrieve the properties and relationships of an [onlineMeeting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/onlinemeeting?view=graph-rest-1.0) object.


For example, you can:


• Get details of an online meeting using videoTeleconferenceId, meeting ID, joinWebURL, or joinMeetingId.
• Use the `/attendeeReport` path to get the attendee report of a [Microsoft Teams live event](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-live-events/what-are-teams-live-events) in the form of a download link, as shown in example 5. (deprecated)
• Use the `/recording` and `/alternativeRecording` paths to get the recordings of a [Teams live event](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-live-events/what-are-teams-live-events) in the form of a download link, as shown in example 6. (deprecated)
